读取任务、事件通知与经营经验: Read quests, event notifications and business experience.
经营经验、当前等级、下级阈值、精确奖励依据与规则: Business experience, current level, next threshold, exact reward evidence and rules.
任务和目标投影，包含当前动作: Quest and goal projections with currently available actions.
明确未知或已知的风险检查: Risk checks with explicit known or unknown states.
当前模拟事件抽取权限和冷却: Current simulation event draw availability and cooldown.
只查询当前公司；真实和模拟进度独立: Queries are company scoped; real and simulation progress remain independent.
目标派生任务只读，完成状态由当前指标计算；任务完成只能提交已存在且成立的结果: Goal-derived quests are read-only and use current metrics; quest completion requires existing, valid results.
建立或修订未结束的经营任务: Create or revise an unfinished business quest.
用准确经营结果完成已接受任务: Complete an accepted quest using exact business results.
记录任务失败或取消并保留历史: Record a quest failure or cancellation and retain its history.
保存经营事件、机会或风险通知: Save a business event, opportunity or risk notification.
确认通知已读，保留实际风险: Acknowledge a notification without clearing the underlying risk.
仅派生系统提醒使用查询返回的依据摘要: Only derived system alerts use the evidence fingerprint returned by the query.
为事件结案或收起保留依据: Resolve or dismiss an event while retaining its evidence.
发现当天的一条模拟经营线索: Discover a simulation business cue for the current day.
已有任务或通知修改使用记录 expected_revision；准确重试使用原: Updates use the record expected_revision; exact retries reuse the original request_id.
任务结果只能引用本公司已有准确版本；目标未达、业务撤回或现金冲销后重新核对有效成: Results must reference exact versions in this company; reassess valid achievements after unmet goals, withdrawn releases or cash reversals.
经验由记录计算，目标、决策、报告与任务共享结果时取最高奖励，不可直接写入经验: Experience is computed from records. Shared results across goals, decisions, reports and quests receive the highest reward once; experience cannot be written directly.
确认已读不解除风险；派生提醒使用查询 actions 中的 fingerprin: Acknowledgement does not clear risks; derived alerts use fingerprint and expected_revision from their returned actions.
模拟事件每天最多抽取一次；牌组权重是游戏规则，不代表真实概率，不自动扣款或推进时: Simulation events can be drawn once per day. Deck weights are game rules, not real-world probabilities; draws do not spend money or advance time.
主持任务、经营线索与有依据的成长反馈: Host quests, business cues and evidence-backed progression feedback.
先读取当前公司 game-state，展示当前任务、重要通知和下一项经营取舍，使: Read the current company game-state first. Present quests, important notifications and the next business tradeoff using stable character names.
任务表达需要取得的结果；目标由指标自动映射为只读主线任务，执行步骤仍由玩家和 A: Quests express outcomes. Goals are projected as read-only main quests from metrics; execution steps remain with the player and Agent.
接受任务、确认提醒仅维护游玩状态，不能伪造经营结果；完成任务先提交结果再引用准确: Accepting quests and acknowledging alerts only maintain play state. Submit genuine results before referencing exact versions to complete a quest.
模拟可探索每日事件牌组，将线索接入已有关系、承诺和资源；保持因果，真实资料变化与: Simulation can explore the daily event deck and connect cues to existing relationships, commitments and resources. Maintain causality and separate factual changes from fictional consequences.
真实模式只从实际记录产生风险，数据不足按未知处理；预测通知写出假设与触发窗口: Real-mode risks use actual records and remain unknown when data is insufficient. Forecast alerts include assumptions and a trigger window.
等级和经验由固定公开规则与有效结果确定；同一依据不可复用刷分，改正账目后重新核对: Levels and experience follow published rules and valid results. Evidence cannot be reused to farm rewards; corrections trigger reassessment.
面向玩家用场景、投入、后果、任务反馈和选择呈现；版本、抽取种子和接口过程留在维护: Present scenes, commitments, consequences, quest feedback and choices to the player. Keep versions, random seeds and interface details in maintenance records.
游戏依据的准确版本在本公司不存在: The exact game evidence version does not exist in this company.
只有模拟公司可以抽取经营事件: Only simulation companies can draw business events.

只能完成已接受的任务: Only accepted quests can be completed.
任务结果尚未成立，不能宣告完成: The quest results are not yet valid, so completion cannot be declared.
任务只能从未结束状态转为失败或取消: Only unfinished quests can become failed or cancelled.
只能将当前提醒结案或收起: Only current alerts can be resolved or dismissed.

推演基线依据摘要或大小不符: The simulation baseline evidence hash or size does not match.
推演基线依据来源不符: The simulation baseline evidence origin does not match.
